age_policy: Headline semantics cap company news/previews7days,company results14days,macro/current-policy35days; actual versus preview is separately screened.
limits: Retrieval-time historical Google RSS/search bytes are archived, not original contemporaneous publisher or full-article vintages.
Finite semantic/release guard coverage and headline-only meaning still require exact own-date editorial review.
Observed response caps are resolved through deterministic daily/complementary branches, but historical indexing/selection does not prove exhaustive reporting coverage.
Any subsequent change to frozen feed/card/provenance or guarded policy requires a separately reviewed revision; no unrecorded amendment is accepted.
